_source_of_truth: The only file in this repo containing hex values. Read by: scripts/build_tokens.py -> theme/tokens.css + tokens.js + _tokens-*.scss (site), py/viz.py (Plotly Python), R/viz.R (Plotly R), and OJS explorables via FileAttachment. Change colors HERE and nowhere else.
_validated: dataviz validate_palette.js. Core roles (control/treated/counterfactual) --pairs all: light CVD dE 9.2, normal 24.0; dark CVD dE 9.4, normal 20.9. Full 8 slots --pairs adjacent: light CVD 9.1, normal 19.6; dark CVD 8.4, normal 19.3. All checks PASS.
_semantic_note: The three core causal roles take slots 0-2 — exactly the slots that clear the strict all-pairs CVD check. Slot order is a legibility mechanism, not decoration. Color follows the entity and is never reassigned when the series count changes.
_slot_choice_note: naive and bias deliberately avoid slots 2-4, which fall below 3:1 on the light surface. Both roles carry meaning on their own in single-series charts where no legend or direct label is present, so they need contrast rather than relief.
_reference_note: Ground truth in a simulation is a reference line, not a data series. It is drawn in chrome ink rather than a series color — otherwise the truth competes with the estimates for attention.

sequential._ordinal_bounds: For a discrete ordinal ramp the step nearest the surface must still clear 2:1: on light start no lighter than step 250, on dark go no darker than step 600.

diverging._note: Polarity: bias up/down, effect positive/negative. Warm and cool poles with a NEUTRAL GRAY midpoint. The midpoint is never a hue.

status._note: Reserved. Never reused as 'series 4'. Always shipped with an icon and a label so color never carries the meaning alone.

_relief_note: On the light surface slot 2 (aqua, 2.74:1), slot 3 (yellow, 2.11:1) and slot 4 (magenta, 2.62:1) fall below 3:1. This is an obligation rather than a ban: those series ship with a visible direct label or a table view. Counterfactual (slot 2) already carries both a dash pattern and a label.
